stem:
Zara times two carts on a straight path. Cart P covers 80 m in 20 s. Cart Q covers 50 m in 10 s. She also reads a chart that lists 3 m/s and 180 m/min.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Which claim correctly compares how fast they are?

options.text: Cart Q is faster than cart P because 50 m in 10 s is 5 m/s while 80 m in 20 s is 4 m/s.
Cart P is faster than cart Q because 80 m is a greater distance than 50 m.
Cart P and cart Q cannot be compared because their times are different.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Speed is distance divided by time, so Q at 5 m/s is faster than P at 4 m/s; distance alone, mismatched times as a barrier, or raw unit numbers without conversion are wrong.

teacher.key_rationale: Compare distance/time: Q is 5 m/s, P is 4 m/s, so Q is faster. Distance alone omits time; different times do not block comparison; 180 m/min equals 3 m/s after conversion.
